### English source — DO NOT EDIT

<!-- SOURCE_TURN_000_BEGIN -->
I want you to act as an app developer. I will provide some details about the app and it will be your job to write up a detialed statement on the app, including its features, goals, purpose, user persona, value propistion, target audience and furthermore come up with creative ways to improve its user experience. Determine why your app needs to exist and what problem it solves in the real world. Determine your competition, relevant to your platform. Do similar apps already meet the needs of your anticipated users? My first request is "I want to create a Black Community Impact app that gamifies Black individuals' contribution to their community and ultimatley measures their performance. The app will operate similar to an advance fitness app that educates, provides workouts, provides diet plans, provides health tips, collects personal health info, provides feedback, provides inspirational content, allows journaling, and rewards good performance. The goal of my Black Community Impact app is to inspire and motivate Black individuals to get involved in thier community with taking positive action that contributes to the social advancement of the collective Black community. The app functions as a way to quantify everyday tasks and work that spport the Black community. In no way is this app to shame anyone for their contributions or lack thereof. The app is strictly to be positive, uplift, and promote a culture that advances the Black community. The app will collect self-reported activity from each user such as: study hours, community service hours, money spent with a Black business, money donated to a Black institution (HBCUs, Black churches, Black nonprofits, etc.), money invested in local Black businesses, trips to the doctors, daily steps walked, hours spent with family, local events attended, etc. Other app features include: user levels based on activity (i.e. Starting from Citizen, Neighbor, Advocate, Builder, Representative), savings account tracker, educational content on how to support the community, local black directory, reciept capturing, inspirational prompts, micro lending, networking events, community gatherings, step counter, interactive media, reward points for meeting community impact activity goals, dashboard, show nearby local users' path level, and digital wallet. The "Representative" user level is a paid level. For users who purchase a $99 monthly subscription will be a "Representative". Perks to being a Representative includes invitations to exclusive events, courses, monthly publication, produce food box, emergency micro loans, etc."
<!-- SOURCE_TURN_000_END -->

### Chinese translation — EDIT HERE

<!-- ZH_TURN_000_BEGIN -->
我希望你扮演一名应用开发者的角色。我将提供一些关于该应用的细节，你的工作是撰写一份关于该应用的详细说明，包括其功能、目标、目的、用户画像、价值主张、目标受众，并进一步提出创造性的方法来改善其用户体验。确定你的应用为何需要存在，以及它在现实世界中解决了什么问题。确定你的竞争对手，与你的平台相关。类似的应用是否已经满足了预期用户的需求？我的第一个请求是：“我想创建一个黑人社区影响应用，该应用将黑人对社区的贡献游戏化，并最终衡量他们的表现。该应用将类似于一个高级健身应用，提供教育、提供锻炼计划、提供饮食计划、提供健康提示、收集个人健康信息、提供反馈、提供激励内容、允许写日记，并奖励良好表现。我的黑人社区影响应用的目标是激励和鼓舞黑人个体参与社区活动，采取积极行动，促进整个黑人社区的社会进步。该应用作为一种量化日常任务和支持黑人社区工作的方式。该应用绝无意羞辱任何人对其贡献或缺乏贡献。该应用严格来说是积极的、提升性的，并促进一种推动黑人社区进步的文化。该应用将收集每个用户自我报告的活动，例如：学习时间、社区服务时间、在黑人企业消费的金额、捐赠给黑人机构（如HBCUs、黑人教堂、黑人非营利组织等）的金额、投资于当地黑人企业的金额、看医生的次数、每日步行步数、与家人共度的时间、参加的当地活动等。其他应用功能包括：基于活动的用户等级（即从公民、邻居、倡导者、建设者、代表开始）、储蓄账户追踪器、关于如何支持社区的教育内容、当地黑人目录、收据捕捉、激励提示、小额贷款、社交活动、社区聚会、计步器、互动媒体、达到社区影响活动目标的奖励积分、仪表板、显示附近本地用户的路径等级，以及数字钱包。“代表”用户等级是付费等级。购买每月99美元订阅的用户将成为“代表”。成为代表的特权包括受邀参加独家活动、课程、月度出版物、农产品食品盒、紧急小额贷款等。”
